description: Prepared Match&Locate dataset folder: templates, continuous data and per-channel phase rows.

templates.csv.notes: template_id matches [A-Za-z0-9._-]+ and names templates/<template_id>/. depth_km is the depth used for the template's travel times and grid center (km below the velocity-model datum). magnitude may be empty; detections then carry NaN magnitude.

channels.csv.notes: One row per correlated channel-phase. channel is the file stem shared by templates/<template_id>/<channel>.sac and continuous/<segment_id>/<channel>.sac. mark is the SAC t-mark index (1 -> t1, 2 -> t2) holding the phase travel time in the template. slowness_h_s_per_deg = dT/dDelta in s per great-circle degree; slowness_v_s_per_km = dT/dz_source in s/km, positive when a deeper source arrives later (upgoing direct ray). A channel may carry several rows (for example P on t1 and S on t2).

layout.templates/<template_id>/<channel>.sac: Template SAC in host (little-endian) byte order. Reference time = template origin (o = 0), the phase travel time in t<mark>, evla/evlo/evdp of the template, user0 = template magnitude, stla/stlo of the station. Must cover [t<mark> - before_s, t<mark> + after_s]. Cut it from the processed continuous data so the self-detection reaches CC = 1.
layout.continuous/<segment_id>/<channel>.sac: Processed continuous SAC (same filter and sampling interval as the templates), o = 0. A segment is a folder scanned together, normally one UTC day (segment_id YYYYMMDD, SAC reference = 00:00:00 of that day) or a window around a known event. All files of one segment share one SAC reference time (detected origin times are reported relative to it), the sampling interval and the begin time (within 1e-3 s); the shortest end time bounds the scan. segment_id matches [A-Za-z0-9._-]+.
layout.config.json: Optional default parameters (see config_schema.json); --config overrides it.

read_only: The dataset is never modified; native jobs reach it through per-job symlinks.
validation: Before any native job: segment folders exist, o = 0, one SAC reference time, uniform delta and begin time per segment, little-endian SAC, template marks defined and covering the correlation window, template/station coordinates present. Any failure stops the run with status=failed.
